newsitem.title: UK: Bowthorpe says sterling hurts profits.
newsitem.headline: Bowthorpe says sterling hurts profits.

text.p: British electronic groups Bowthorpe Plc said on Wednesday that currency translation so far this year was hitting pretax profits at an annual rate of 7.0-8.0 million stg.

"So far this year, sales and orders have shown modest underlying growth, but weaker markets, especially in Europe, have led to a decline in operating margins -- although we have seen some recovery in April," chairman Anthony Vice said in a statement from the company's annual meeting.
He added that sterling's strength, particularly against European currencies, had continued to hurt profits through translation.
Bowthorpe's shares slipped 2.5p to 317.5 by 1135 GMT. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
